      [marketing-section-title kind=centered size=medium]
        h2 "Hiring process"
        p "Every role goes through the same five stages, from the first request to the offer."
    list (5): Role request A hiring manager requests a new role. · Scope and posting We define the role’s scope, write the job description, and post the opening on selected channels. · Recruiting and interviews We source and screen candidates, then schedule interviews and, when the role needs one, a technical assessment. · Calibration Interviewers meet to compare feedback and choose the candidate. · Offer letter We prepare the offer and send it to the chosen candidate.
